4050-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
4050-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie Cat, adding one mana of any color
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Repeat.
4050-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

2842-4279-5687--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-4279-5687--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1424-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
1424-4687-4929.description:
Activate Presence of Gond by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4222-4289-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

967-2921-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

1594-4399-4518-5870.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-5870.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

443-1580-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

789-1263-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Pir and Primal Vigor.

Repeat from step 1.

Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Sami.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Sami.
Repeat.

2366-2800-4359-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2800-4359-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1365-1651-3698-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-3698-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

1274-3490-4050-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4050-6719.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.

1737-2397-3094-4636.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Prototype Portal's ability.
Resolve the copy of Prototype Portal's ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the original Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put either Gonti's Aether Heart token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate the remaining Gonti's Aether Heart token by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {R}.

2698-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Vogar's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Vogar.

Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.

Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
